instruction: Please help enable the 'Show GIMP logo' option at the bottom of the toolbox.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the GIMP logo (Wilber) display at the bottom of the toolbox via Edit > Preferences > Toolbox. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (toolbox-wilber yes) using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts GIMP config state: get_gimp_config_file retrieves the gimprc file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric logic is sound: check_config_status correctly parses the config file format and checks for the key-value pair (toolbox-wilber yes)
Postconfig is necessary and correct: Ctrl+Q closes GIMP to ensure config changes are written to disk before verification
Expected values are semantically correct: 'toolbox-wilber' with value 'yes' is the correct config setting for enabling the GIMP logo display
Complete coverage: The single requirement in the instruction (enable GIMP logo option) is fully verified
Parameter handling is correct: Metric receives rules dictionary directly as expected when type='rule', accessing rule['key'] and rule['value'] properly
